_readme: Published owner fees of property managers that serve Horry County, read from each firm's own web page on the date in raw/fees/index.json. Each value is copied from the page text saved in raw/fees/<id>.txt (line given). Firm names are kept here for the verifier; the page shows the counts and the range, never a verdict on a named firm. Long-term = leases of a year; short-term = nightly and weekly stays.

Deluxe 15% with 40% leasing and $50 renewal; a leasing-only plan at one month's rent ($1,000 minimum), $500 renewal
